channel.title: Luis's AI Brief
channel.description: A free weekday brief on AI for marketers.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 27, 2026
item.description: A physicist credits GPT-6 Astra with help on a new quantum gravity theory, AI shopping agents face their first big Black Friday, and Nvidia pauses server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 26, 2026
item.description: OpenAI claims its AI proved the exact speed limit of matrix multiplication, Anthropic's CEO answers an Axios report on human control of AI, and ChatGPT's Chat and Work move to one shared usage meter.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 25, 2026
item.description: Google requires AI agents to use its MCP servers for Gmail and Drive, DeepMind tests whether AI gets easy questions right every time, and CrowdStrike agrees to buy Zscaler for $43.9 billion.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 24, 2026
item.description: Nvidia's board brings its CEO back after 10 days, Anthropic launches Claude Ship agents for code review, and two states sue SpaceX over Grok's safety claims.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 23, 2026
item.description: A Claude-assisted Riemann hypothesis proof passes its first independent checks, OpenAI's chief scientist proposes shared limits for AI labs, and a hit game pulls its AI music.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 20, 2026
item.description: Anthropic's first trading day ends well below its open, Reuters tests Meta's Muse agent, and OpenAI measures how much research its agents finish alone.

item.title: Luis's AI Brief: November 19, 2026
item.description: Anthropic prices its IPO above range in a record raise, banks put customers on the hook for AI agents, and government testers get chatbots past their safeguards.
